scope: Independent read-only execution-order review before any B/C fit
finding: run() calls fit_and_seal_models() before prepare_account_sources(). Training preparation verifies model and guidance sources, but the current raw-price, controller and native reference identities are not rechecked at fit start. A changed account source can consume up to six fixed fits before the account preflight detects it.
existing_evidence: account_source_preflight.json is a valid prior snapshot bound to this plan; it does not itself assert source bytes remain identical when fit begins.
required_repair: Before R.start or any fit attempt, verify the pinned raw-price, guard, schedule, controller, action-selection, release and reference Recorder artifact hashes against the approved plan without loading 2023+ evaluation returns. Keep full account-object loading and all outcome reads behind the six-model prediction seal.
